Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If someone plays Rotschrek on Hector Trelane, then does he not burn
because he is not sent to torpor "in combat" or does the "in combat"
only apply if he is burned?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:


In combat applies to both conditions, as there is only an opposing
minion during combat.

(sent to torpor) or (burned) in combat
not
(sent to torpor) or (burned in combat)

Hector Trelane
Tremere
Capacity: 5
Group: 4
Independent. Hector can play strikes that require Thaumaturgy that are
not usable on the first round during the first round of combat. If
Hector is sent to torpor or burned in combat, he is burned, and the
controller of the opposing minion gains 4 pool.
Artist(s): Thomas Denmark
Set(s): Gehenna:U

Messages.Author: LSJ
